title: No default-deny
detail: default_action='allow' and no final deny-all rule
fix: Set implicit/explicit deny-all at the end of every rule set (inbound and outbound).

title: Any/any/any allow rule
detail: inbound allow with no restriction on source, destination, port or protocol
fix: Delete or replace with specific source/destination/port rules (least privilege).

title: Admin/database service exposed to the internet
detail: inbound from ANY to ['any'] on ALL PORTS
fix: Restrict to VPN/ZTNA/bastion source ranges with MFA; never expose RDP/SMB/DB ports publicly.

title: Unrestricted egress
detail: outbound from ['10.10.20.0/24'] to ANY on ANY port
fix: Implement egress filtering: allow only required ports (e.g. 443, 53 to internal resolvers) and route web traffic through a proxy/SWG. Limits C2 and exfiltration.
